description: The design warnings, and the errors only publishing refuses, that validate.go and the front end's validate.js must agree on (DesignWarnings in warnings.go and the device settings among PublishBlockers in topology.go, collectWarnings in validate.js, which marks the errors blocksPublish). Each case changes document.json as the cases of validation-corpus.json do, and the document stays valid. Its warnings are the issues of the codes listed here (codes, and blockers for the errors) that both sides give for it, each with its code, path and message, and its field when it has one, in any order. Read by TestWarningCorpus and validate.contract.test.js.
